I choose: New nuclear

One reason is that new nuclear power provides a high and reliable firm capacity, which is essential for meeting the binding constraint of firm capacity during the worst week of the year. Nuclear power plants have a high capacity factor and can operate continuously, ensuring a stable and consistent power supply, whereas wind plus storage struggles to meet this requirement due to its intermittency and the high costs associated with scaling up storage solutions.
